findings.reason: a coordinator reading the existing relationship would dispatch the deletion once the producer plan is satisfied, while the true gate (the ambix consumer migration) is unowned.
findings.text: the deletion is made conditional on "imas-ambix has migrated off nova.imas.machine_artifact before any file is deleted" (§3:104, f-mdr-currency, §4:124), but `plan-depends-on` points at `imas-ambix:machine-map-transform-engine`, a different plan whose scope is the producer, and the ambix plan that owns that migration boundary (`docs/nova-physics-consumer-integration.html`, whose `plan-informs` lists `nova-scoping-review,hybrid-generative-state-estimation,nova:mast-nonaxisymmetric-physics` and not this plan) states at line 89 that "what is missing is the Ambix-side boundary" — so the hard prerequisite has no owning node and the declared dependency is not the one the deletion actually waits on

findings.reason: a node dispatched against §4 cannot reach its done-when, so its gate is unreachable by construction and its completion cannot be judged.
findings.text: §4 is declared `implementable` in `plan-section-declarations` and the S24 classification comment calls its equivalence demonstration "the one node buildable now; nothing is deleted under it", yet §4's own done-when requires "every surface in the §3 inventory removed or re-homed per its disposition" while §3 is declared `deferred`

findings.reason: seven-plus independent deliverables under one gate means no node can be closed on one verdict and the gate proves none of them individually.
findings.text: one done-when carries the numeric equivalence demonstration, the removal of the registry schema and digests, the re-home of the OCI publication capability and the DDv4 floor, the geometry migration into the MAST map, the deletion of the IDS builder, the rewiring of ~12 kLOC of consumers, the calibration decoupling, and the coordination of the ambix identity migration

findings.reason: the section that states why the layer is retired asserts the publication path is dead and generically replaced, so a node reading §1 would delete a live publication path the plan elsewhere treats as an owner-directed capability to preserve.
findings.text: §1 states the retiring layer is "a content-addressed artifact cache with an OCI reference helper that nothing publishes through" and that "the map-driven producer in imas-ambix replaces all three generically" (line 37), but §2 corrects exactly this ("the old §2 argument that 'nothing publishes through the helper' is therefore false today", line 57, against `nova/scripts/diiid_machine_artifact.py`, 513 LOC) and §3's disposition requires the publication capability and DDv4 floor to be RE-HOMED because the producer does not carry them

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — every cited file:line resolves to the named symbol (`nova/media/sources/mast_efit.py:29`, `scripts/mast_reference_evidence/contours.py:110`, `nova/imas/mast_solve_inputs.py:74-75`, `nova/io/sourcemap.py:44`, `imas_ambix/gs/machine_identity.py:152`, `imas_ambix/gs/artifact_geometry.py:767`, `imas_ambix/gs/artifact_resolution.py:315-316,171,268`), commits `0dfda59a`/`1df19c16` resolve, and `782e9e08` resolves as the DIII-D conductor-table digest prefix in `docs/plans/diiid-forward-onboarding.html:481` (not a commit, and correctly cited as a digest); the §3 LOC figure for `nova/imas/mast_geometry.py` is stale (647 claimed, 662 lines at head) but is a size claim only.
rubric_items.done_when: a finding — §4 is declared `implementable` while its own done-when requires every §3 surface removed, and §3 is declared `deferred`, so the buildable node is measured against a done-when it is forbidden to satisfy.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the plan names no scratchpad; its gate outcome is "a committed receipt" and "demonstrated numerically", which is durable, so no session-local or node-local path is relied on.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the sprint/followup identifiers (S10/S15/S16/S22/S24, f-mdr-001) live in the plan document, not in any symbol the plan creates, and the symbols it will create are named by mechanism (`latest_publication_dd_version`, `publication_dd_version`, `default_registry`).
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §1's stated root cause ("nothing publishes through the helper"; "the producer replaces all three generically") is contradicted by the plan's own §2 and §3.
rubric_items.single_goal: a finding — §4's one done-when bundles the equivalence demonstration, six independent removals/re-homes, the calibration decoupling, and a cross-repo migration, so no single node can be closed on one verdict.
rubric_items.wiring: a finding — the plan's deletion gates on imas-ambix migrating off `nova.imas.machine_artifact`, but `plan-depends-on` names only the producer plan (`imas-ambix:machine-map-transform-engine`) and no relationship wires the migration that actually gates the deletion.
